title: 菊花賞の後に・三冠ウマ娘

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon wins the Kikuka Sho and fulfills her and her father's dream of becoming a Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to have her run in the spring Tenno Sho in order to complete her second goal of "inspiring courage" in others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She suddenly remembers the way Rice Shower looked during the race and gets an unsettled feeling in her chest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the same feeling she gets when she hears talk of Tokai Teio. It seems she's gained a particular awareness of other runners in a way she's never had before.
